registered_before: the isolated final panel produced a single game
why: A campaign that has retracted three of its own reported results should state what it expects BEFORE measuring, so the final interpretation cannot be quietly shaped by the outcome. These are falsifiable and will be scored against the panel verbatim.

basis.override_cost: ~18 points, from pooled ablation arms (to be reconfirmed pinned)
basis.c019_prior_ablation: c019 measured its ByteRL priors at -28.7 points against pure MCTS

C020_CORRECTED_MCTS.reason: the search overrides ~8% of decisions and overriding costs ~18 points; the corrected machinery is neutral otherwise

C020_CORRECTED_BYTERL.reason: better trained than the c019 control (0.05-0.13) -- working option references, 5 merit promotions, 16x more multi-select play -- but 104,000 self-play games from random init is small, and it has never seen a scripted opponent

C020_H0.reason: baseline priors + tactical heuristic; should track corrected MCTS

C020_H1.reason: ByteRL priors replace baseline priors; c019 measured its own priors at -28.7 points, and a prior from a policy scoring ~0.2 should still hurt

C020_H2.reason: leaf value only; c019's ablation put the value cost at -2.5 points, an order of magnitude smaller than its prior cost

C020_H3.reason: both adapters; dominated by the prior term

C020_H4.reason: ByteRL priors with a 50/50 heuristic-value blend; the blend should recover some of what H3 loses on value but none of the prior damage

ordering_prediction: BASELINE > {C020_CORRECTED_MCTS ~ H0 ~ H2} > H4 > {H1 ~ H3} > C020_CORRECTED_BYTERL > C019_BYTERL_CONTROL

gate_predictions.corrected_mcts_gate: FAIL -- requires baseline +3 points; expected ~15 points below
gate_predictions.corrected_byterl_gate: FAIL -- requires beating c019 ByteRL materially AND baseline +2; the first is plausible, the second is not
gate_predictions.hybrid_gates: FAIL for all five -- each must beat the stronger corrected pure parent by 3 points, and no adapter is expected to improve on H0

what_would_surprise_me: corrected MCTS above 0.50 -- would mean the override damage is smaller than the ablation says
corrected ByteRL above 0.35 -- would mean 104,000 self-play games is enough to approach a hand-written agent, contradicting c019 at 80,000
any hybrid beating H0 -- would mean a ByteRL component helps a search, which neither c019 nor c020 has yet seen
H1 or H3 above H2 -- would invert the prior-versus-value damage ordering c019 measured
how_this_will_be_scored: each interval is hit or missed, stated per candidate in SUMMARY.md with no re-interpretation of the interval after the fact
